newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish industrial climate cools in Nov - statoffice.
newsitem.headline: Polish industrial climate cools in Nov - statoffice.

text.p: Sentiment in Poland's manufacturing sector cooled in November for the second month running as future expectations were less optimistic than in October, the Central Statistics Office (GUS) said on Thursday.

In its monthly survey GUS said the industrial climate index fell to one point in November from two points in October as companies cut production in line with only a small growth of demand expected in future months.
GUS said the worsening was more pronounced among private companies and small firms last month, but they were still better off than state-owned firms.
It said the construction sector climate fell for the seventh month running, dropping 13 points to two points as expectations about future orders worsened.
BUSINESS OUTLOOK NOV OCT SEPT AUG JULY NOV 95
NOTE: The indicator is a percentage balance between positive and negative responses from polled companies.
